Messages.Author: Patrick van der Reest

Hello!

Redesigning one of my older decks, and looking for a fortitude press,
I cam across this strange problem:

Can I play Hidden Strength for X=-1, thus prevent 0 and gaining one
blood, with an optional press in superior?

Hidden Strength, Combat
Cost: X

(for) Prevent X+1 damage.
(FOR) As above, with an optional press.

Thanks,

Patrick
Columbus, OH
